summary_ja: サケやマスを凍らせたまま薄く切って食べる刺身。雪に埋めて凍らせ寄生虫を防ぎながら保存していたアイヌ発祥の食べ方と伝わり、口の中でじわりと溶けていく食感が持ち味とされる。
summary_en: Salmon or trout is sliced thin while still frozen and eaten raw — said to descend from an Ainu method of burying fish in snow to preserve it and guard against parasites, prized for how it melts slowly in the mouth.
